public_pages.for_native_subscriptions_re: For native subscriptions, RevenueCat processes the account UUID, product, app store and purchase status. Apple or Google processes payment. The family shares access through a server-verified subscription; the app does not store payment cards or raw receipts in family data. A paired wall display uses its own anonymous sign-in identity with limited access. An adult can remove access under Family → Devices. Pairing codes expire and are stored only as hashes on the server.
public_pages.the_family_shares_recipes_i: The family shares recipes, images, personal ratings and links to meals and shopping. Images are stored privately for the family. Photo scanning sends your selected photos to OpenAI to read the recipe, only when you press Analyse. Review the result before saving. Original photos are used as covers only if you choose. Library text and ratings are cached on the device for offline viewing.
public_pages.familiekalender_stores_your: Familiekalender stores your email, account ID and family memberships. Supabase Auth handles passwords. The family shares events, notes, places, tasks, completion status, recurrence, reward history, meal plans, ingredients and shopping with member accounts.
public_pages.people_in_the_calendar_are_: People in the calendar are family profiles, not automatically user accounts. Name, colour, optional birth year, avatar and task settings may be stored. The adult creating or inviting people to the family must have permission to share their information. Other members can read and edit shared calendar and profile data.
public_pages.rewards_include_monthly_all: Rewards include monthly allowance calculations and payment status, bonus stars with a history, the family reward catalogue, goals, redemption requests, adult approvals and reasons for excused chores. The family can read this information. Adults manage approvals and settings. The app does not transfer money. History is preserved when a person is archived and is included in family export and deletion.
public_pages.avatars_are_stored_in_a_pri: Avatars are stored in a private Supabase Storage bucket and shown with expiring links. Older avatars may use external image links. Google, Aula and other ICS links are stored on the backend and fetched by a Supabase Edge Function. These links may grant access to private calendars; only owners/administrators can see them, and they are excluded from JSON exports.
public_pages.this_device_stores_the_sign: This device stores the sign-in session, calendar, people, rewards, meal plans, shopping and pending changes locally so the app can work offline. Only share the device with people allowed to see the family. Signing out clears local family data and pending changes. Appearance and wall display settings, including a salted PIN hash, are kept for the next sign-in. System backups may have a different lifetime.
public_pages.android_ios_registers_a_ran: Android/iOS registers a random installation ID, account, selected family, platform, app version and last active time. If push is configured and you grant permission, an APNs/FCM token is also registered. There is no reminder engine yet. The app does not collect advertising IDs, precise location, contacts, microphone data or motion data.
public_pages.supabase_processes_accounts: Supabase processes accounts, databases, files and server functions; the backend project is in EU West (Ireland). Vercel hosts the web app. Apple/Google handles any push registrations. Auth email requires an SMTP provider, still to be decided. Infrastructure may process IP addresses and operational logs. The app has no advertising or analytics/tracking SDK.
public_pages.data_is_kept_while_the_fami: Data is kept while the family uses the service, until members delete it or the family is deleted. Inactive families are not automatically deleted. Under Account you can export the selected family's data as JSON and delete your account. Family data is kept for other owners; your author references are anonymised. If you are the only owner, each family must be explicitly deleted in the flow. Child profiles in a retained family are not deleted with your login.
public_pages.deleting_a_family_removes_i: Deleting a family removes its calendar, meal plans, shopping, people, feeds, memberships, rewards and avatar files. Account, profile, login memberships, invitations and device registrations are removed. If network cleanup fails, an internal deletion job is saved and completed on the next attempt. Other devices' offline copies can only be cleared when they reconnect or sign out. Provider backups and security logs expire according to agreed retention periods; the exact production periods must be decided before public launch.
public_pages.on_native_devices_a_tempora: On native devices, a temporary JSON file is stored in the app's private cache while you share it. The app clears it on sign-out or account deletion, and at the next start/export once it is over 24 hours old. You must delete any copies you save or share yourself.
public_pages.before_public_launch_specif: BEFORE PUBLIC LAUNCH: specify the data controller, support email, SMTP provider, legal basis and agreed retention periods. Requests for access, correction or deletion must be possible through the published contact.
public_pages.one_subscription_gives_one_: One subscription gives one family access on its devices. The app store shows the current price, period, any trial and renewal before you confirm the purchase.
public_pages.purchase_restore_and_manage: Purchase, restore and management happen in the iOS or Android app where the subscription is available. A cancelled subscription retains access until its confirmed expiry date.
public_pages.purchases_are_not_open_yet_: Purchases are not open yet. Final terms, provider details and support contact must be established before app store launch.

public_pages.export_the_selected_family_: Export the selected family through Settings → Account. Account deletion can be started here on the web or in the app. Sign in to confirm deletion.
